title: 🪞 Perfect Mirror
description: ✨ Both subtrees are perfect mirror images.

title: 💔 Broken Reflection
description: 🔍 Matching values appear in non-mirrored positions.

title: 🌱 Single Node
description: ✅ A single-node tree is symmetric by definition.

title: 🍃 Two Unequal Children
description: ⚖️ The left and right child values do not match.

title: 🌳 Symmetric Tree with Missing Children
description: 🪞 Both sides have matching values and mirrored missing nodes.

title: 🧩 Asymmetric Structure
description: 🚫 The child nodes occupy matching rather than mirrored positions.

title: 🔢 Negative Node Values
description: ✅ Negative and positive values can form a symmetric tree.

title: 🌲 Deep Symmetric Tree
description: 💪 Multiple levels preserve the mirror-image structure.
